rationale: Identity was correctly verified via email. However, the agent fabricated product details: it presented a 10x-zoom variant (item ID 9228757377, SD card, $3,066.23) that was not shown in the product tool results and labeled it as available despite the tool indicating the 10x option was unavailable. The agent also executed a cancellation without explicitly restating the exact change (which order) and obtaining a confirmation to proceed, as required by policy, given the user had multiple orders. Finally, the agent stated refund timing (5–7 business days) without tool-backed confirmation. These issues violate the policy against inventing facts and the requirement to confirm exact order-changing actions before writing.
